recipes.title: Andalusian Gazpacho
recipes.procedure:
Soak the stale bread in the vinegar with a splash of water.
Roughly chop the vegetables and blend them with the garlic and salt, adding water until it is as thick as you want it.
With the blender running, pour in the oil.
Chill at least two hours. Do not sieve it: the fibre is the point.

recipes.title: Chilled Courgette and Basil Soup
recipes.procedure:
Soften the chopped onion in the oil, then add the courgettes and the potato in pieces.
Cover with the stock, season, and cook fifteen minutes.
Add the basil at the end of cooking, off the heat, and only then blend: off the heat it stays green and keeps its scent.
Cool it completely, and spoon the yogurt over each bowl to serve.

recipes.title: Farro Salad with Roasted Vegetables
recipes.procedure:
Dice the aubergine, courgette and pepper, dress them with a little of the oil and roast them.
Cook the farro, then cool it under running water.
Mix it with the roasted vegetables and the crumbled feta.
Finish with the rest of the oil, the lemon zest and the basil.

recipes.title: Panzanella
recipes.procedure:
Wet the stale bread with water and vinegar, squeeze it and crumble it.
Cut the tomatoes over a bowl to catch their juice: that juice is the dressing.
Dice the cucumber and slice the red onion thinly.
Mix everything with the oil, the basil and the salt, and let it rest an hour.

recipes.title: Wholewheat Couscous with Chickpeas and Lemon
recipes.procedure:
Hydrate the couscous with about 270 ml of boiling salted water, then separate the grains with a fork.
Cut the tomato, cucumber, pepper and spring onion into small dice.
Add them raw, with the chickpeas, the lemon juice, the oil and the cumin.
Stir in the parsley and basil: be generous with the herbs.

recipes.title: Aubergines Stuffed with Lentils
recipes.procedure:
Halve the aubergines, score the flesh in diamonds, and bake at 200 degrees for twenty-five minutes.
Meanwhile stew the onion in the oil, then add the cooked lentils, the passata, the cumin and the oregano and cook ten minutes.
Fill the aubergines with the lentils and scatter the crumbled feta over.
Give them another ten minutes in the oven.

recipes.title: Tray of Roasted Summer Vegetables
recipes.procedure:
Cut the aubergine, courgette, pepper and red onion into big pieces and halve the cherry tomatoes.
Dress them with the oil, oregano and salt with your hands in a bowl: that uses far less oil than pouring it over the tray.
Spread everything out and bake at 200 degrees for thirty minutes.

recipes.title: Courgette and Feta Burek
recipes.procedure:
Salt the grated courgettes and leave them to drain twenty minutes, then squeeze them hard with your hands: skip this and the burek comes out soggy.
Mix them with the stewed onion, the crumbled feta, the ricotta, the egg, the dill and the pepper.
Lay out a sheet of phyllo, brush it lightly with the yogurt and oil, spread filling along one side, roll it into a cigar and coil it into a round tin. Carry on with the other sheets.
Brush the top and bake at 190 degrees for thirty-five minutes.

recipes.title: Light Spanakopita
recipes.procedure:
Wilt the spinach in a pan with no added water, then drain and squeeze it thoroughly.
Mix it with the chopped spring onion, the feta, the ricotta, the egg, the dill, the nutmeg and the pepper.
Line a tin with half the phyllo, brushed lightly with the yogurt and oil, pour in the filling and close with the rest.
Score the portions before it goes in, and bake at 190 degrees for forty minutes.

recipes.title: Phyllo Cigars with Aubergine and Feta
recipes.procedure:
Bake the aubergine and pepper in cubes at 200 degrees for twenty-five minutes, with the onion.
Crush them roughly with the feta, the parsley and the paprika.
Cut the phyllo sheets in half, put a spoonful of filling on each half, fold the sides in and roll it up tight.
Brush them and bake at 200 degrees for twenty minutes.

recipes.title: Light Krompirusa
recipes.procedure:
Grate the raw potato on the coarse holes; grate the courgette and squeeze it dry.
Mix them with the chopped onion, the parmesan and plenty of black pepper. The filling goes in raw and cooks inside.
Spread it along the phyllo sheets, roll each one up and lay them out in a spiral.
Brush the top and bake at 190 degrees for forty-five minutes.

recipes.title: Aubergine and Ricotta Involtini
recipes.procedure:
Slice the aubergines lengthways and grill the slices in a pan or in the oven.
Mix the ricotta with the parmesan, the lemon zest and the basil, put a teaspoon on each slice and roll it up.
Soften the onion in the oil and simmer it with the passata into a simple sauce.
Sit the rolls on the sauce and bake twenty minutes at 190 degrees.

recipes.title: Tzatziki
recipes.procedure:
Grate the cucumbers and wring them out in a tea towel: this is the step that decides whether it works.
Mix them with the yogurt, the crushed garlic, the dill, the oil, the salt and a little vinegar.
Let it rest an hour before serving.

recipes.title: Roasted Pepper and Feta Cream
recipes.procedure:
Roast the peppers whole at 220 degrees for thirty-five minutes.
Shut them in a covered bowl for ten minutes, then peel them: the skins come away on their own.
Blend the flesh with the feta, the yogurt, the paprika and the vinegar.
Season with black pepper and finish with the oil.

recipes.title: Cannellini Cream with Garlic and Rosemary
recipes.procedure:
Warm the oil with the garlic and the rosemary for two minutes to flavour it, then take the rosemary out.
Blend the beans with the flavoured oil, the lemon juice and a few spoonfuls of their cooking water until smooth.
Season with the salt and the black pepper.
Judge the water so it stays soft: it firms up in the fridge.

recipes.title: Roasted Courgette and Ricotta Cream
recipes.procedure:
Cut the courgettes into thick rounds and roast them at 220 degrees for twenty-five minutes.
They have to dry out and take colour; boiled, they make the cream watery.
Blend them with the ricotta, the parmesan, the lemon zest, the spring onion and the basil.
Season with salt and chill.

recipes.title: Courgettes in Scapece
recipes.procedure:
Cut the courgettes into thin rounds and griddle them in a non-stick pan over a high flame, or under the oven grill.
Layer them in a container with the sliced garlic, the basil and the salt.
Pour the vinegar and the oil over.
Leave them to marinate at least three hours.

recipes.title: Mediterranean Chickpea Salad
recipes.procedure:
Drain the chickpeas.
Cut the cherry tomatoes, cucumber, red onion and olives into dice.
Mix everything with the oregano, the parsley, the lemon juice and the oil.
Let it stand at least half an hour.

recipes.title: Lentil Salad with Red Onion
recipes.procedure:
Slice the red onion thinly and marinate it ten minutes in the vinegar.
Emulsify the mustard with the oil and the vinegar.
Dress the cooked lentils, the halved cherry tomatoes, the onion and plenty of parsley with it.
Rest thirty minutes before serving.

recipes.title: Cannellini, Rocket and Cherry Tomatoes
recipes.procedure:
Crush a third of the beans lightly with a fork: it makes a cream that binds the dressing and lets you use less oil.
Halve the cherry tomatoes and slice the spring onion.
Mix everything with the oil, the lemon zest and the black pepper.
Add the rocket at the last moment.

recipes.title: Quick Pickled Cucumbers
recipes.procedure:
Slice the cucumbers thinly.
Mix them with the vinegar, the sugar, the salt, the black pepper and the dill.
Leave twenty minutes before serving.

recipes.title: Raw Courgette Ribbons
recipes.procedure:
Peel the courgettes into ribbons with a vegetable peeler.
Dress them with the lemon juice, the oil, the salt and the black pepper.
Add the shaved parmesan and the basil.
Leave ten minutes before serving so the ribbons soften.

recipes.title: Roasted Peppers in Salad
recipes.procedure:
Roast the peppers at 220 degrees for thirty-five minutes.
Peel them and cut the flesh into strips.
Dress them with the garlic in slivers, the capers, the parsley, the vinegar, the salt and a little oil.

recipes.title: Quick Confit Cherry Tomatoes
recipes.procedure:
Halve the cherry tomatoes and lay them on baking paper.
Season with the salt and the oregano and trickle the oil over.
Bake at 200 degrees for twenty-five minutes, until they have concentrated and turned very sweet.
